children: Overview
US home retailer's preliminary Q3 net revenue grew 5.8%, slightly missing analyst expectations
Non-GAAP diluted EPS up 11.7% yr/yr to $2.19
Company reiterated full-year 2026 outlook
Shares of the company fell around 13%, and were set for their worst day in nearly 20 months if losses hold
With shares up 52% in the last six months, expectations were high heading into the results, Telsey Advisory analysts said
Outlook
Williams-Sonoma expects fiscal 2026 net revenue growth of 4.7% to 7.2%
Company sees 2026 comparable brand revenue growth of 4.0% to 6.5%
Williams-Sonoma forecasts 2026 non-GAAP operating margin between 17.8% and 18.2%
Result Drivers
TARIFF REFUNDS - Co said gross margin benefited from IEEPA tariff refunds in Q3
OCCUPANCY LEVERAGE - Co said improved occupancy leverage contributed to higher gross margin
HIGHER SUPPLY CHAIN COSTS - Co said increased supply chain costs due to higher oil prices partially offset margin gains
